paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Average overall performance 0.90\% of all LLMs across both KGDS patterns. The stratification is divided into three levels: Tier-1 (OP_{avg} [61, 69]), Tier-2 (OP_{avg} [53, 56]), and Tier-3 (OP_{avg} [29, 37]).

model_annotations.English: This vertical bar chart illustrates the average overall performance of various Large Language Models (LLMs) across knowledge-grounded discussion summarization patterns. The horizontal category axis lacks an overarching title and specific category labels, displaying only unmarked tick marks beneath twelve individual bars. The vertical value axis is labeled "Average Performance (%)" and uses a linear scale with a visible labeled range from 0 to 60, featuring numeric tick marks at intervals of 20, though the chart area extends upward to accommodate values near 70. Light grey horizontal and vertical gridlines divide the background. The chart consists of twelve discrete vertical bars, each rendered in a different muted or pastel color and explicitly annotated with its exact value at the top. Moving from left to right, the colors and their corresponding annotated values are: muted teal (68.66), muted purple (61.11), muted steel blue (29.44), muted mauve (66.41), muted blue-grey (62.98), muted brown (36.62), light blue (65.77), light lavender (55.69), light peach (55.00), light grey (55.30), light beige (52.61), and light pink (55.55). The tallest bar is the first one on the left at 68.66%, while the shortest is the third bar from the left at 29.44%. The bars are not sorted in an ascending or descending numerical sequence, nor are they grouped or stacked, and visual emphasis is provided uniformly through the exact numeric labels placed above each bar.
model_annotations.German: This vertical bar chart illustrates the average overall performance of various large language models (LLMs) evaluated on knowledge-grounded discussion summarization, as indicated by the context. The vertical axis is a value axis labeled "Average Performance (%)" featuring a linear scale with numeric tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 20, starting at 0 and extending upward to accommodate the maximum value. The horizontal axis represents the different model categories; however, it lacks an explicit axis title and specific textual category labels, presenting only small black tick marks beneath each position. The chart contains 12 individual vertical bars, each rendered in a distinct muted color such as teal, purple-grey, blue-grey, mauve, slate blue, tan, light blue, lavender, light tan, light grey, pale olive, and light pink. Every bar is visually emphasized with an exact numeric text annotation positioned directly above its top edge. The bars are not arranged in a specific ascending or descending sorted order. Moving from left to right, the annotated values for the 12 bars are 68.66, 61.11, 29.44, 66.41, 62.98, 36.62, 65.77, 55.69, 55.00, 55.30, 52.61, and 55.55. The tallest bar is located on the far left with a maximum value of 68.66, while the shortest bar is the third from the left, representing a minimum value of 29.44. Light grey vertical grid lines are evenly spaced across the background to visually separate the chart area.
